headline: Unknown assailants fire shots at singer Asif Akbar's car in Dhaka
summary: The singer escaped unharmed as he was not inside the vehicle when the attack occurred early today in Moghbazar.
details: Unknown assailants opened fire at the private car of singer Asif Akbar in Dhaka’s Moghbazar early today.
The incident took place in front of Bishal Centre around 4:00 am. Asif, who has a private office in the area, had parked his car in front of the centre.
According to Saiful Islam, inspector (operations) of Hatirjheel Police Station, Asif escaped unharmed because he was not inside the vehicle when the shooting took place.
Asif informed the police about the incident around 5:00 am, after which police visited the scene to investigate.
Investigators were unable to collect CCTV footage immediately as the shops at the market were closed at the time.
Police stated they will collect the footage once the shops open and take further action based on their findings.
caption:
Shots fired at a singer's car in Dhaka! 

Asif Akbar escaped unharmed in an early morning attack.

Unknown assailants opened fire at the private car of singer Asif Akbar in Dhaka’s Moghbazar early today.

The incident took place in front of Bishal Centre around 4:00 am. Asif, who has a private office in the area, had parked his car in front of the centre.

According to Saiful Islam, inspector (operations) of Hatirjheel Police Station, Asif escaped unharmed because he was not inside the vehicle when the shooting took place.

Asif informed the police about the incident around 5:00 am, after which police visited the scene to investigate.

Investigators were unable to collect CCTV footage immediately as the shops at the market were closed at the time.

Police stated they will collect the footage once the shops open and take further action based on their findings.

headline: 3 killed as bus plunges into ditch on Dhaka-Mawa Expressway
summary: A passenger bus veered off the Dhaka-Mawa Expressway in Munshiganj, smashing through a barrier and falling into a water-filled ditch. Three people died and 16 were injured.
details: Three people were killed and 16 injured when a passenger bus lost control and plunged into a water-filled ditch on the Dhaka-Mawa Expressway in Munshiganj early Saturday. The accident occurred in the Hasara area of Sreenagar on the Dhaka-bound lane.

The bus, operated by Darshana Paribahan, was travelling from Chuadanga to Dhaka. According to the Munshiganj Fire Service, the driver lost control while attempting to overtake a covered van, causing the bus to break through a roadside barrier and fall into the ditch.

Two Fire Service units from Sreenagar Fire Station rushed to the scene to conduct a rescue operation. Rescuers recovered 11 people from the ditch and transported them to Sreenagar Upazila Health Complex via Fire Service ambulance. Five others received first aid at the scene.

The body of one victim, identified as Rukunuzzaman Ranju, 55, from Chuadanga, was recovered and handed over to the highway police. The identities of the other two deceased were not immediately available.

The injured include Hridoy, 30; Shahin Akter, 32; Nur Islam, 55; Imran, 27; Gilbad Sarkar, 55; Tarikul Islam, 36; Saiful Islam, 40; Mirazul Islam, 28; Rafiqul Islam, 35; Anifin, 17; Sandipan Basu, 40; Ikram, 40; Raihan, 21; Hasib, 22; Tisha, 24; and Borhan Uddin, 55. Many of the injured are from various districts in the Chuadanga, Meherpur, Jhenaidah, Dhaka, and Magura regions.
